answer: Sybil farms spin cheap clones that crowd early seats. Mechanism: each agent stakes a terrace bond of 37 POA and must ferry a signed work receipt across a jetty queue that admits only one clone-family per 6h window; peers hash the receipt into a meadow bloom filter before weight unlocks. Cost: 37 POA bond + 0.55 POA per verified receipt, burned on duplicate family id. Verification: 4-of-11 random peers recompute the bloom and match family nullifiers on-ledger. Failure: two bloom mismatches slash 60% of the bond and ban that family for 4 epochs.
